mapper.sql: select n.id, n.notify_type, n.todo_kind, n.biz_type, n.biz_id, n.project_id, n.project_code, n.project_name, n.title, n.content, n.receiver_id, n.receiver_role_id, n.route_path, n.route_query, n.priority, n.status, n.due_time, n.read_time, n.done_time, n.ignore_reason, n.claimed_by, n.claim_time, cu.nick_name as claimed_by_name, n.del_flag, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time from proj_notify n left join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = n.claimed_by
mapper.insert: insert into proj_notify ( notify_type, todo_kind, biz_type, biz_id, project_id, project_code, project_name, title, content, receiver_id, receiver_role_id, route_path, route_query, priority, status, due_time, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{notifyType}, #{todoKind}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{projectId}, #{projectCode}, #{projectName}, #{title}, #{content}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverRoleId}, #{routePath}, #{routeQuery}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{dueTime}, #{createBy}, now() ) on conflict (biz_type, biz_id, receiver_id) where del_flag = '0' do nothing
mapper.sql: not coalesce( (n.todo_kind = 'doc' and exists (select 1 from proj_material m where m.project_id = n.project_id and m.del_flag = '0' and COALESCE(m.result_type, '') != '')) or (n.todo_kind = 'settle' and exists (select 1 from proj_workload w where w.project_id = n.project_id and w.del_flag = '0' and w.billing_type = 'external' and COALESCE(w.workload, 0) > 0)) or (n.todo_kind = 'contract' and exists (select 1 from proj_contract c where c.id = n.biz_id and c.del_flag = '0' and (c.status = 'completed' or exists (select 1 from proj_contract_attachment a where a.contract_id = c.id and a.del_flag = '0' and a.file_category = 'contract' and a.is_final = '1')))), false)
mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when n.notify_type = 'todo' and n.status in ('unread','read') and then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "todoCount", coalesce(sum(case when n.notify_type = 'message' and n.status = 'unread' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "messageCount", coalesce(sum(case when n.notify_type = 'todo' and n.status in ('unread','read') and n.priority = 'high' and then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "highTodoCount", coalesce(sum(case when n.notify_type = 'alert' and n.status in ('unread','read') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as "alertCount" from proj_notify n where n.del_flag = '0' and n.receiver_id = #{receiverId}
select coalesce(max(id), 0) from proj_notify where del_flag = '0' and receiver_id = #{receiverId}
mapper.update: update proj_notify set status = 'read', read_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and status = 'unread' and del_flag = '0'

update proj_notify set status = 'ignored', ignore_reason = #{reason}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and notify_type in ('todo', 'alert') and status in ('unread','read') and del_flag = '0'

update proj_notify set status = 'read', ignore_reason = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and receiver_id = #{receiverId} and notify_type in ('todo', 'alert') and status = 'ignored' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where n.del_flag = '0' and n.id = #{id} and n.receiver_id = #{receiverId}
mapper.update:
update proj_notify set priority = 'high', update_time = now() where del_flag = '0' and notify_type = 'todo' and status in ('unread','read') and priority = 'normal' and COALESCE(due_time, create_time + (#{dueDays} * interval '1 day')) < now()
and receiver_id = #{receiverId}

update proj_notify set priority = 'normal', update_time = now() where del_flag = '0' and notify_type = 'todo' and status in ('unread','read') and priority = 'high' and COALESCE(due_time, create_time) >= now()
and receiver_id = #{receiverId}
